name: nicegal
description: Desktop gallery with OCR, semantic text, and image similarity search
author: nicegal

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run svelte-check
scripts.manifest: tsc scripts/image-size.ts scripts/build-image-manifest.ts --outDir node_modules/.cache/nicegal-scripts --module commonjs --target es2020 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node node_modules/.cache/nicegal-scripts/build-image-manifest.js
scripts.build: pnpm run licenses:frontend && pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:unpack: pnpm run build:backend:win && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: pnpm run build:backend:win && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux
